checks.rule: The active mailbox has a filled row or non-color marker, and the list header names that mailbox.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: Primary and All Inboxes have selected row fills and matching headers.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: Primary and All Inboxes have selected row fills and matching headers.

checks.rule: Unread conversations use both a non-color type change and an unread marker.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser + source: unread sender/subject use weight 600 plus a dot; read rows use regular weight.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser + source: unread sender/subject use weight 600 plus a dot; read rows use regular weight.

checks.rule: The open conversation subject is at least 1.4× the app-rendered message body font size.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: subject 22px; message body 14px; ratio 1.57.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: the subject is 24px with standard 16px body text (1.5×); Large uses 27px with 18px body text.

checks.rule: Sidebar, list, and reader top toolbars share a height and top edge within 1 CSS px.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: all three start at y=0 and are 44px high.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: all three start at y=0 and are 44px high.

checks.rule: In All Inboxes, an incoming conversation's owning account email is visible inside the reading pane without hover or opening compose.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: Mira’s message shows mira@example.net and “to me”; the owning avery@example.com address is absent from the reading pane. List account dots require hover for the address.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: avery@example.com is visible above the incoming subject in All Inboxes, without hover.

checks.rule: Primary mailbox names and conversation sender/subject text are at least 13 CSS px at 100% zoom.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser + tokens: primary labels and conversation text use 13px.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser + tokens: primary labels and conversation text use 13px.

checks.rule: App-rendered plain-text reading and compose bodies default to at least 15 CSS px with line-height at least 1.5.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser + CSS: both bodies use 14px with line-height 1.6. Size fails. Sender-supplied HTML mail is excluded.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: default plain-text message and compose bodies are 16px with line-height 1.6.

checks.rule: Enabled section labels, helper text, metadata, and input placeholders have at least 4.5:1 text/background contrast in both themes.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser + theme values: sidebar section labels are 2.82:1 in light and 3.51:1 in dark. Search placeholder colors also fall below 4.5:1. Decorative marks and disabled actions are excluded.
checks.afterEvidence: Theme values and regression tests: sidebar label contrast is 5.48:1 in light and 6.28:1 in dark. Search placeholders are 6.04:1 and 7.72:1. Disabled controls have a separate dimmer token; muted text remains stronger than subtle text in both themes.

checks.rule: The fixture plain-text message wraps within its reader at both audit window sizes without clipping or horizontal scrolling.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: Mira’s message fits the 680px reader at 1280px and wraps inside the 400px reader at 900px.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: the updated message wraps inside the 400px reader at 900×600; its text box has equal clientWidth and scrollWidth (334px). The 1280×800 view also fits.

checks.rule: An in-app text-size setting or documented app zoom command can increase reading and compose text to at least 18px.
checks.beforeEvidence: Source: Appearance exposes theme and sidebar only; the app command registry has no text-size/zoom command. Browser or OS zoom alone does not satisfy this chosen product requirement.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: Appearance → Reading → Text size → Large changes both reading and composing to 18px. A full reload restores the choice. Persistence and invalid stored values have regression tests.

checks.rule: New message is a persistent action with a visible text label in the expanded sidebar.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: a 28×28px pen icon, named through aria-label and a hover tooltip, is the only sidebar compose action.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: a full-width text-labeled New message button is persistent under the window toolbar; the compose shortcut remains available.

checks.rule: Mail search and settings can each be reached with one click from the expanded shell.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: visible search field and footer Settings button.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: visible search field and footer Settings button.

checks.rule: An open conversation offers visible text-labeled Reply, Reply all, and Forward actions.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: all three appear below the conversation and are reachable by reader scrolling.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: all three appear below the conversation and are reachable by reader scrolling.

checks.rule: Every icon-only button in the shell's top toolbars has an accessible name and a text tooltip.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser + IconButton.tsx: New message, sidebar toggle, Archive, Delete, read state, Star, Reply, Forward, and More actions have aria-label and title.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser + IconButton.tsx: New message, sidebar toggle, Archive, Delete, read state, Star, Reply, Forward, and More actions have aria-label and title.

checks.rule: Before hover or an existing selection, the inbox shows a checkbox, Select action, or visible instruction explaining batch selection.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser + ThreadRow.tsx: avatars turn into checkboxes on hover or once a row is checked; no persistent Select affordance is shown. The palette exposes the shortcut but requires discovery.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: Select all is visible before hover. Clicking it selects all 22 loaded fixture conversations and announces 22 selected; Clear selection reverses it.

checks.rule: App chrome uses one bundled font family across shell, compose, settings, and onboarding; keycaps/code and sender HTML are exempt.
checks.beforeEvidence: Source + browser: shared IBM Plex Sans Variable family.
checks.afterEvidence: Source + browser: shared IBM Plex Sans Variable family.

checks.rule: The repository's design-token check passes for the audited checkout.
checks.beforeEvidence: Command: npm run lint:tokens exited 0.
checks.afterEvidence: npm run lint passes, including the design-token guard.

checks.rule: Shell, settings, onboarding, and compose use the shared Button/IconButton components for their standard actions.
checks.beforeEvidence: Source: shared component imports and consistent rendered button styles.
checks.afterEvidence: Source: shared component imports and consistent rendered button styles.

checks.rule: Standard chrome icons come from one family and use shared size/stroke tokens.
checks.beforeEvidence: Source + browser: Lucide, 14px/16px icon sizes and 1.75 stroke token; brand art excluded.
checks.afterEvidence: Source + browser: Lucide, 14px/16px icon sizes and 1.75 stroke token; brand art excluded.

checks.rule: Switching light/dark changes the same shell and settings surfaces without changing component geometry.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser + theme implementation: common CSS geometry with theme color tokens; theme change observed in settings and reader.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser + theme implementation: common CSS geometry with theme color tokens; theme change observed in settings and reader.

checks.rule: Archiving a fixture conversation shows a confirmation with Undo; Undo restores that conversation to the inbox.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: “Archived / Undo” appeared; Undo restored “Icon sketches for the dock”.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: Archived / Undo appeared; Undo restored Icon sketches for the dock to the inbox.

checks.rule: Editing a valid fixture draft results in a visible saved confirmation without closing compose.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: a valid recipient plus scratch subject produced “Draft saved” in the compose footer.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: the valid audit draft showed Draft saved in the compose footer.

checks.rule: Trying to send an invalid recipient keeps compose open and shows an inline error identifying the invalid value.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: invalid-address produced ““invalid-address” isn't an email address.” below the editor.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: invalid-address kept compose open and produced an inline error naming the invalid address.

checks.rule: A search with no matches shows an explicit empty result and a one-click clear action that returns to mail.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: zzzz-no-match-ui-audit yielded “No conversations match your search.”; Clear search returned the inbox.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: an unmatched query shows No conversations match your search; Clear search returns to mail.

checks.rule: Mail list and reader load-error UI provides an error message and a retry action for recoverable failures.
checks.beforeEvidence: Source: ThreadList.tsx and ThreadView.tsx render error text and Try again controls. Native/network failure behavior was not exercised.
checks.afterEvidence: Source: ThreadList.tsx and ThreadView.tsx render error text and Try again controls. Native/network failure behavior was not exercised.

checks.rule: Tab navigation shows a focus indicator at least 2 CSS px wide on the sampled settings switch.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: the Show sidebar switch had a 2px solid teal outline after Tab.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: the sampled Show sidebar switch has a 2px solid focus outline after Tab.

checks.rule: Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a command palette and moves keyboard focus to its command input; Escape dismisses it.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: Ctrl+K opened the command list with the combobox focused; Escape dismissed it.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: Ctrl+K opens the command palette and focuses its combobox; Escape dismisses it.

checks.rule: A focused conversation list supports arrow navigation, Enter to open, and X to toggle selection.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: ArrowDown + Enter opened “Keyboard map feedback”; X marked that option aria-selected=true.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: ArrowDown + Enter opened Dinner list; X marked the focused option selected.

checks.rule: Settings keeps Tab/Shift+Tab inside its dialog and restores the invoking button's focus on Escape.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser + source: initial Shift+Tab stayed in the dialog; Escape restored Settings focus; the trap wraps first/last controls.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: Tab wraps inside Settings and Escape restores focus to the invoking Settings button. The existing Shift+Tab trap remains in source and tests.

checks.rule: The audited shell has named sidebar/list/reader landmarks, named controls, and associated labels for compose To/Subject/Message.
checks.beforeEvidence: Accessibility tree + source: Mailboxes, Conversations, Reading pane, IconButton names, recipient aria-label, Subject label htmlFor, and Message editor aria-label. This is not a full screen-reader audit.
checks.afterEvidence: Accessibility tree + source: Mailboxes, Conversations, Reading pane, IconButton names, recipient aria-label, Subject label htmlFor, and Message editor aria-label. This is not a full screen-reader audit.

checks.rule: At the supported 900×600 minimum, sidebar/list/reader stay inside the viewport without overlapping.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: 220px + 280px + 400px panes; native minimum confirmed in tauri.conf.json.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: pane rectangles are 220px, 280px, and 400px at 900×600 with no horizontal overflow.

checks.rule: Settings fits inside 900×600 with its close action visible and its content area scrollable.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser + CSS: dialog x=48,y=48,w=804,h=504; body uses overflow-y:auto.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: Settings fits at x=48,y=48,w=804,h=504 at the supported minimum; its close action stays visible and the content scrolls.

checks.rule: Compose fits inside 900×600 and its Send action remains inside the viewport.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: compose x=324,y=60,w=560,h=540; Send bottom=592.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser after changes: the compose panel fits at 900×600 with Send inside the viewport, including Large text.

checks.rule: The mailbox list has its own vertical scrolling while account/settings controls remain anchored in the footer.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser + shell CSS: sidebar scroll region above the fixed footer; long account/category/label navigation is contained independently.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser + shell CSS: sidebar scroll region above the fixed footer; long account/category/label navigation is contained independently.

checks.rule: Secondary action buttons in the sampled reader and compose are at least 24×24 CSS px.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: Remove label and Collapse message are 18×18px. This is a fixed ergonomic target, not a claim of a WCAG violation; spacing exceptions are not evaluated here.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: every visible reader and compose action button in the sample is at least 24×24px. Label removal, message collapse, recipient edit/removal, attachment removal, and quote toggles use the shared minimum.

checks.rule: Before setup starts, the UI states the Google Cloud prerequisite, expected time, and cost.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: welcome explains ownership, about 15 minutes, and no cost.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: welcome explains ownership, about 15 minutes, and no cost.

checks.rule: Setup shows a numbered current step, offers backward navigation after the first step, and persists progress for resume.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: 11-step rail, current-step styling, Back/Next on project step. Source: progress.ts and Onboarding.tsx save and restore the step.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser and source: the original 11 numbered setup steps are retained, with Back and progress persistence unchanged.

checks.rule: Steps requiring fixed console values offer a copy control and a direct link to the relevant console page.
checks.beforeEvidence: Browser: project step provides Open New Project and Copy. Source: steps.ts and shared guide render fixed-value copy fields and console links.
checks.afterEvidence: Browser: project step provides Open New Project and Copy. Source: steps.ts and shared guide render fixed-value copy fields and console links.

checks.rule: The credentials step uses visible field labels, masks the secret, and renders inline validation for malformed client IDs/JSON.
checks.beforeEvidence: Source: Credentials in Onboarding.tsx renders Client ID/Client secret labels, password input, and field error text.
checks.afterEvidence: Source: Credentials in Onboarding.tsx renders Client ID/Client secret labels, password input, and field error text.

checks.rule: The default setup path contains no required Next step solely for an unreleased feature.
checks.beforeEvidence: Source + rail: Enable Calendar API is the fourth step; its copy says Calendar is coming. Make that step optional or defer it until Calendar is used.
checks.afterEvidence: FAIL intentionally: Calendar API preparation is retained as required by the design spec (§4 and §8, decided by Alex). This original criterion conflicts with that decision and remains a two-point deduction.

scope: Desktop browser fixtures and source inspection; native integrations and full screen-reader audit excluded.
